ns2:section.sectionText: This class will meet in C120 CLSL. Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 27, 2012. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 18, October 16, and November 13, 2012. This course will be reserved for MCB and BIOC seniors until April 11 and then MCB and BIOC juniors until April 17. Any remaining seats will be unrestricted April 17.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Biology or Biochemistry or Molecular and Cellular Biology major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
